_comment: Beta updates use this repository’s normal Latest GitHub release and a pinned public publisher key. Empty pins fail closed. auto_check: once the owner turns on “Go online on its own”, VOOL checks this feed on its own (daily); while that switch is off nothing is fetched. The Mac launcher supplies its live bundle/helper/health paths; installed Linux discovers its receipt. Publisher-verified ad-hoc Mac bundles require both Ed25519 signatures, SHA-256 and deep strict codesign; a certificate-signed running app still requires Gatekeeper acceptance. See docs/RELEASE_KEY_CEREMONY.md.
